description: Live offers from all exchangers serving the pair for the given amount, best first: amount received after all fees, rate, KYC rating (A best … D), ETA, limits, and a swap_url per offer for the user to complete the exchange. Rate-limited (answers are cached for a minute); do not poll.

from_network.description: Network of the sent coin, e.g. TRX for USDT on Tron. Required when the coin lives on several networks.

max_kyc.description: Only exchangers with this KYC rating or better (A = no KYC expected).

name: get_quotes
title: Compare exchangers for an amount
